title: galarhoeus pekinensis var. hupehensis
intro: Galarhoeus pekinensis var. hupehensis, commonly known as Chinese milk vetch or hupeh milk vetch, is a plant species in the family Leguminosae. It is a perennial legume native to China, valued for its medicinal properties. The plant is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues, thanks to its anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents of Galarhoeus pekinensis var. hupehensis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and health benefits, making it a valuable herb in traditional Chinese medicine.
